# drAIn

> Drainage flood simulation and citizen flood reporting for Mandaue City, Philippines.

drAIn maps the city's drainage network (inlets, outlets, storm drains and pipes), simulates how it floods under a chosen rainfall with the Storm Water Management Model (SWMM), and lets residents report blocked or damaged drains with a photo. City engineering staff track and resolve those reports.

## Pages

- [Home](/): what drAIn is
- [Map](/map): the drainage network, flood hazard overlays and citizen reports
- [Simulation](/simulation): flood hazard per component under adjustable rainfall
- [Dashboard](/dashboard): report and repair statistics
- [Documentation](/docs): features, data sources, architecture and limitations
